title: My Mother's Birthday
sentences: It was my mother's birthday last Saturday.
We did not tell her about the party.
My sister cooked and I bought the cake.
Twenty people came to the house.
When my mother opened the door, she was very surprised.
She laughed and then she cried a little.
We ate, and later my uncle played the guitar.
The last people left after midnight.
My mother said it was the best day of the year.
